The player auction for the [[2026 Pakistan Super League]] was held on 11 February 2026 in [[Lahore]]. It was the first time in PSL history that selection was done through a [[player auction]] system for the eleventh season, replacing the [[Draft (sports)|draft method]] that had been used since the league began in [[2016 Pakistan Super League players draft|2016]].<ref name="tribune1">{{Cite news |date=25 November 2025 |title=PCB announces HBL PSL XI players auction on Feb 11 |url=https://tribune.com.pk/story/2588987/p |work=The Express Tribune |access-date=28 January 2026}}</ref><ref name="Dawn2" />

==Background==
Ahead of the 2026 season, the PSL expanded from six to eight teams following the auction of two new franchises [[Hyderabad Kingsmen]] and [[Rawalpindiz]].<ref name=schedule>{{cite news |url=https://www.geonewsurdu.tv/latest/429611 |title={{Nq|پاکستان سپر لیگ 11 کے شیڈول کا اعلان کردیا گیا}} |date=10 March 2026 |accessdate=10 March 2026 |author={{Nq|سہیل عمران}} |publisher=Geo News |language=ur}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |url=https://jang.com.pk/news/1565670 |title={{Nq|ٹیم 'پنڈیز' نے سوشل میڈیا اکاؤنٹس پر نام 'راولپنڈیز' کردیا}} |date=17 March 2026 |accessdate=18 March 2026 |work=Daily Jang |author={{Nq|فیضان لاکھانی}}}}</ref> The [[Pakistan Cricket Board]], along with all eight franchises, agreed to replace the draft system with a player auction starting from the 11th season, allowing franchises to bid openly for players for the first time in PSL history.<ref name="tribune1" /><ref name="BR1">{{Cite news |title=HBL PSL announces major structural reforms |url=https://www.brecorder.com/news/40403015 |website=[[Business Recorder]] |author=Muhammad Saleem |date=20 January 2026 |access-date=28 January 2026}}</ref>

Previously, since its inaugural season in 2016, the PSL had been using a player draft system to form team squads till the ten seasons. Under this system, players were grouped into fixed categories (Platinum, Gold, Silver etc), and franchises selected players in a set order rather than through open bidding.<ref>{{cite news |title=Ramiz Raja wants PSL to move from draft to auction |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/pcb-chairman-ramiz-raja-wants-psl-to-move-from-draft-to-auction-1305561 |author=Danyal Rasool |website=ESPNcricinfo |date=14 March 2022 |accessdate=18 March 2026}}</ref>

==Signing and auction rules==
Team purse was capped at {{PKR|45.0 crore}} and allowed be extended to {{PKR|50.5 crore}} to allow direct signing of one foreign player who has not featured in previous season. All eight PSL franchises bid openly for players with all bids and minimum incremental increases in [[Pakistani rupee]]s. Players entered the auction with set base prices at four tiers:<ref name="DawnRules" /><ref name="ESPNRules" />
* {{PKR|4.2 crore}}
* {{PKR|2.2 crore}}
* {{PKR|1.1 crore}}
* {{PKR|0.6 crore}}
Minimum bid increments vary by price level, with franchises free to bid above the prescribed minimum amounts. Franchises were allowed to select 16 to 20 players, including five to seven overseas players depending on squad size, and must include at least two uncapped Under‑23 players, with one featured in the playing XI. Players selected at the auction enter two‑year contracts with their franchises. Franchises may also directly sign one foreign player who did not play in the previous season outside of the auction process. These signings would be outside of team purse which can be extended to accommodate such direct signings.<ref name="DawnRules">{{Cite news |title=PCB announces player auctions for upcoming Pakistan Super League on Feb 11 |url=https://www.dawn.com/news/1969005 |website=[[Dawn (newspaper)|Dawn]] |date=25 January 2026 |access-date=28 January 2026}}</ref><ref name="ESPNRules">{{Cite news |title=PSL 2026 auction to take place on February 11 |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/pakistan-news-psl-2026-auction-to-take-place-february-11-1520921 |author=Danyal Rasool |website=[[Cricinfo|ESPNcricinfo]] |access-date=28 January 2026 |date=25 January 2026}}</ref>

Each franchise was allowed to retain a maximum of four players from its existing squad, limited to one player per category, if mutual agreements were reached before the auction. Previously, teams could retain up to eight players and had additional mechanisms such as the right‑to‑match (RTM) option, mentor roles, and brand ambassador places under the draft system. The PCB abolished the RTM option, mentor and brand ambassador provisions for PSL 11.<ref name="Dawn2">{{Cite news |title=Player auction model to replace draft system for PSL XI |url=https://www.dawn.com/news/1967839 |website=[[Dawn (newspaper)|Dawn]] |date=19 January 2026 |access-date=28 January 2026}}</ref>

The two newly inducted franchises were permitted to pre‑select and retain up to four players each from the available pool before the main auction, to match the retention numbers of the existing six franchises.<ref name="Dawn2" /><ref name="DawnRules"/>

==Retentions==
Franchise were allowed to retain upto four players, one in each category before the auction, new franchises were allowed to sign four players to match the retentions of other six franchises.<ref name="Dawn2" /><ref name="DawnRules" />

==Direct signings==
Teams were allowed to directly sign one foreign player before the auction who has not played in the previous season on PSL.<ref name="ESPNRules" /> These signings were outside of the team purse and were up to PKR 55m.<ref name="DawnRules" /><ref name="Ret55m">{{cite news |title=Peshawar Zalmi confirm Babar Azam's retention price |url=https://a-sports.tv/peshawar-zalmi-confirm-babar-azam-retention-price |publisher=[[A Sports]] |date=4 February 2026 |accessdate=18 March 2026}}</ref>
